name: Formaggio

categories.label: Banca (Italian Cheese Bank)
categories.hint: Rows with 2+ cheeses score 2/5/9/10 (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum); columns with 2/3/4 cheeses score 4/10/18. Platinum counts in the 3 columns beneath it. Enter the total.

categories.label: Venezia (Gondolas)
categories.hint: Count each Gondola once per adjacent own cheese token, then use the board rubric.

categories.label: Vigneto (Wine)
categories.hint: Count complete Wine Bottles, then use the board rubric.

categories.label: Regioni (Regions x Flags)
categories.hint: Regions with your cheese x total flags on cities with your cheese.

categories.label: Fruit (Fruited Cheese x Jam)
categories.hint: Fruit used for Fruited Cheese x Fruit used for Jam.

categories.label: Completed Order Cards
categories.hint: Number of completed Orders; points from the scoring rubric (e.g. 4 orders = 8 pts). Enter points from rubric.

categories.label: Structure scoring abilities
categories.hint: Sum of end-game Structure ability points (player board and Structure tiles).

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, victory is shared.

endCondition.description: When a player places their final Cheese Token they declare game end; the game ends after all players finish that turn.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Venezia, Vigneto and Order point values come from rubrics printed on the board/score pad and are not in the rulebook text, so they are scorer inputs (Orders example: 4 orders = 8 pts; 4 bottles = 7 pts; 7 gondolas = 7 pts). Solo Corporation mode and Fromage-venue integration not modelled. Official PDF (BGG file 424579) could not be downloaded (Cloudflare block); text taken from RulesPal's reproduction, so needsReview=true.
